accelerators.role: discover evidenced customer problems and demand
convert validated specs into complete customer artifacts
deterministic repetitive generation, sync, indexing and packaging
independently verify deployment, links, telemetry and external outcomes
prepare B2B licensing, partnership, bundle and distribution opportunities
compact durable project state, evidence and handoff context

design_rules: Use scripts/direct calls before agents when deterministic logic suffices.
Use specialist agents for focused context or parallelism.
Apply least privilege and existing owner gates.
Bound retries, context and model/tool cost.
Independent verification required for consequential external completion claims.
